# Captain Saul

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventy-six years old  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v4 c7 P14](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0014), [v4 c15 P39](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0039)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c19 P46](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 c7 P11](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0011), [v4 c9 P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Lighthouse keeper at Seven Gulls Point (formerly sea captain)  <sub>[v4 c5 P1](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0001), [v4 c7 P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045)</sub>
- **Titles:** Captain Saul; Captain Garrick  <sub>[v4 c6 P7](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Captain Saul is a tall, stooped, and somewhat awkward man with a weathered, bronzed, and heavily furrowed face. He has a broad, plain forehead, a thin jaw, and a thick mane of iron-gray hair hanging to his shoulders. His deep-set, exceptionally blue eyes often twinkle with humor, dream, or gaze out toward the sea.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c6 P15](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0015), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c15 P39](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0039)_

## Personality

Captain Saul possesses a gentle, pure-hearted, and deeply romantic nature, combined with an intense love for beauty and the ocean. He is an exceptionally natural narrator who delights in telling sea stories, and he possesses a quiet, resilient optimism that helps him endure hardships. Highly empathetic, tender, and caring toward both people and animals, he holds a firm, unyielding sense of duty and honor.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v4 c6 P14](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0014), [v4 c9 P5](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0005), [v4 c9 P20](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0020), [v4 c9 P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 c17 P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019)_

## History

Captain Saul spent fifty years roaming the globe as a sea captain, surviving numerous shipwrecks, fires, and mutinies. Over fifty years prior to his death, he lost his young sweetheart, Margaret, to the sea during a sudden squall, a tragedy that led him to remain unmarried for the rest of his life while cherishing her memory. In his later years, he retired from the sea and became the lighthouse keeper at Seven Gulls Point. He maintained a close friendship with the young newlyweds Nell and Hugh Carrow, sharing his rich life stories and welcoming them into his circle of 'kindred spirits.' Later, he provided the material and inspiration for Adrian Treleaven to write his published biography. After thirty years of tending the Seven Gulls lighthouse, Captain Saul passed away peacefully in his sleep at the age of seventy-six, resting with his finished 'life-book' in his hands.

_Sources: [v4 c7 P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 c7 P45](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0045), [v4 c9 P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036), [v4 c9 P49](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0049), [v4 c20 P14](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0014), [v4 c20 P17](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0017), [v4 c24 P0](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0000), [v4 c25 P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 c39 P25](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0025), [v4 c39 P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_
